hypotheses: H1: Measure conditional geometry/correction effects under private BN at both levels of the other ingredient; benefit is not assumed.
H2: Exploratory directional AUC moderation J_private-J_shared>0; report its opposite, zero, and all per-seed outcomes.
H3: Measure BN effect in each ingredient cell and preserve AUC/BCE tradeoffs.
scope.interaction_definition: J_n=Y[n,1,1]-Y[n,1,0]-Y[n,0,1]+Y[n,0,0]; deltaJ=J_private-J_shared. Positive deltaJ with negative J_private is reduced antagonism, not positive within-private interaction.

metrics.BCE: Mandatory secondary;RESULT.selected_VALID.loss for all cells; negative deltas favor treatment; selected by AUC, no BCE reselection.

scope.normalization_interpretation: Shared BN was fixed in the original factorial, so its conditional interaction is valid. Shared running-state mixing may moderate ingredient effects; this is not yet a proven cause. Different own-selected epochs and horizons preclude isolated same-weight buffer causality.
scope.population: Three training seeds, one official scaffold split, complete151-graph selected VALID; TEST closed. Routes and molecules do not enlarge training-seed n.
scope.reporting: All24 cells and all9 new admission/terminal outcomes; every seed and raw signed contrast; mean/sampleSD only with all3 required seeds, labeled sign-count n. Preserve selected/trained epochs, curves, stop reasons, cap/failure/missing states and actual costs.
